name: Homemade New York-style pizza (36-hour cold-fermented dough)
description: New York-style pizza recipe with strong flour, 63% hydration, olive oil and sugar, a 36-hour cold ferment, uncooked sauce and low-moisture mozzarella.
keywords: new york style pizza, new york pizza recipe, ny style pizza dough, new york pizza dough, homemade pizza, cold ferment pizza dough
recipeIngredient: Grated Parmesan, dried oregano and chili flakes to taste

recipeInstructions.name: Mix the dough
recipeInstructions.text: Dry-mix 530 g of flour, 1.1 g of instant dry yeast (or 3.2 g of fresh, dissolved in the water) and 8.0 g of sugar. Dissolve 11 g of salt in 334 g of cold water (10–15 °C). Pour the water into the flour and mix until no dry flour is left. Cover and rest 20 min. The flour hydrates and the kneading gets shorter.

recipeInstructions.name: Knead
recipeInstructions.text: Knead 5–6 min on the bench with no extra flour: push with the heel of your hand, fold and give a quarter turn. Stop when the dough has come together and is starting to turn smooth. The oil goes in now, not before: fat gets in the way of gluten.

recipeInstructions.name: Add the oil and finish kneading
recipeInstructions.text: Add 13 g of olive oil a little at a time and work it in with pincers and folds until the dough absorbs it all and stops slipping. Knead 3–5 min more, until the dough is smooth and elastic. Windowpane test: stretch a piece into a thin membrane. If it tears right away, knead a little more.

recipeInstructions.name: First rest
recipeInstructions.text: Shape into a ball, place it in a lightly oiled bowl and cover. Leave 1 h at room temperature. It should rise only a little.

recipeInstructions.name: Divide, ball and refrigerate
recipeInstructions.text: Divide into 3 dough balls of 299 g (total dough 897 g). Ball with surface tension and seal the base well. Individual lightly oiled tubs, covered, in the fridge for about 36 h.

recipeInstructions.name: Temper the dough balls
recipeInstructions.text: Take them out of the fridge about 2 h before baking, still in the covered tub. Ready when: relaxed, slightly puffy, bubbles on the sides and soft to the touch.

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare sauce and cheese
recipeInstructions.text: Briefly blend or pass through a food mill 1 can(s) of peeled tomatoes: a smooth, thick, uncooked sauce. Season with 4–5 g of salt per can and 1 teaspoon of dried oregano. Optional: a pinch of sugar and 1 grated garlic clove. Coarsely shred 360 g of low-moisture mozzarella (the firm block kind). Set aside grated Parmesan, oregano and chili flakes for finishing.

recipeInstructions.name: Preheat the BIG HORN
recipeInstructions.text: Top element at 350 °C, bottom element at 300 °C. If you have an infrared thermometer, measure the centre of the stone: the target is ~290–320 °C.

recipeInstructions.name: Stretch the dough
recipeInstructions.text: Flour the dough ball well on both sides. Press the centre with your fingertips, leaving about a 1 cm rim. Lift the dough and stretch it over your knuckles, rotating, to ~30–32 cm. The disc ends up thin and even, with an almost translucent centre.

recipeInstructions.name: Top and launch
recipeInstructions.text: Dust the peel with semolina and lay the disc on it. Spread 90 g of sauce in a thin layer, up to ~1 cm from the edge. Cover with 120 g of shredded mozzarella, almost to the edge. Give it a short sideways shake: the whole pizza must slide.

recipeInstructions.name: Bake and turn
recipeInstructions.text: Turn 90–180° every ~1 min for an even bake. Done when: cheese melted with browned spots and a golden rim. Lift the edge with the peel: the base should be firm and spotted, not pale.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish and slice
recipeInstructions.text: Rest 1–2 min on a wire rack so the base doesn't go soft. Finish with Parmesan, oregano and chili flakes. Cut into 6 to 8 slices. To eat, fold the slice in half.
